notes.title: Pick a template for each page
notes.text: Choose how a page is laid out from the templates your theme offers, like single, full or with a sidebar. Template replaces the old Wide and Side options.

notes.title: Edit your header and footer
notes.text: Appearance now has a screen each for Header and Footer, with every setting and a live preview on a phone and a computer. You can also add an action button to the header.

notes.title: See when a button is working
notes.text: Buttons now show a loading indicator while their action runs, for example Save, Install, Update and Uninstall.
An app’s page has the tabs Settings and Information
On a large screen, block and section settings open in a side panel
Section color is now in Section settings
Cards follow Material 3: more room inside, they rise when pointed at, and cards that link get a tint
The menu shows who’s signed in and your site’s domain at the top
Buttons in the editor are as wide as their label, never across the screen
The text toolbar has round corners and room all round it
The row that deletes what a screen shows, like Delete page, is in the error color
The Appstore says it can’t reach the store after 15 seconds, instead of waiting forever
